name: MDMP
summary: MDMP, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylphentermine or as α-methyl-MDMA, is a lesser-known psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDx families.

pharmacology.text: MDMP failed to act as a serotonin releasing agent in rat brain synaptosomes in vitro.

uses.en: It has been studied very little and has no medical or established recreational use.
uses.zh: 它的研究非常少，沒有醫療用途，也沒有確立的娛樂用途。
uses.zhHans: 它的研究非常少，没有医疗用途，也没有确立的娱乐用途。

fact.en: MDMP adds an extra methyl group to MDMA's alpha carbon, making it the MDMA counterpart of phentermine. In rat brain tissue it failed to release serotonin.
fact.zh: MDMP 在 MDMA 的 α 碳上多加一個甲基，使它成為芬特明在 MDMA 家族中的對應物。在大鼠腦組織中，它無法釋放血清素。
fact.zhHans: MDMP 在 MDMA 的 α 碳上多加一个甲基，使它成为芬特明在 MDMA 家族中的对应物。在大鼠脑组织中，它无法释放血清素。
